name: amazon-orders-sync-extension
description: Chrome + Safari extension that syncs Amazon orders, items and returns to a Tailscale-hosted server

scripts.safari:xcode: node scripts/build.mjs safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location dist/xcode --app-name "Amazon Orders Sync" --bundle-identifier com.mohit.tools.amazon-orders-sync --macos-only --no-open --no-prompt --force
